content:
The **Old Danielson Cabin** is a location in the mountains in the northern Savage Divide in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Ghoul Within* update.

Prior to the Great War, the cabin was used by Hetty Danielson, a university professor, and Mr. Danielson, her husband. The latter had insisted that Hetty takes some time away from the stress of teaching, as one of her students crept her out, resulting in her feeling followed and acting more and more paranoid. After three days at the cabin, Hetty had become frantic and had claimed to have seen her student on multiple occasions, which caused her husband to contemplate if he shouldn't have brought her to the Allegheny instead. [1] 

It turned out that Hetty has been right all along, as her student was a cannibal and obsessed with her, to the point that he followed the couple to their cabin in the middle of nowhere. When Mr. Danielson left the cabin, the student introduced themself to him, and soon after killed him. This was witnessed by Hetty, who did not show the gratitude that the student had hoped for, and thus Hetty was killed by them as well. The student then conserved the bodies of the Danielsons, placing their skulls on the fireplace mantel, and made the place their own, where they could pursue their culinary desires in a secluded space. [2] 

The student then continued to live in the cabin, doing bi-weekly car trips to the Red Rocket Mega Stop, where they would kidnap victims in their car's trunk, and later consume them at the cabin, before placing their bones in the grave site west of the cabin. It was during one of those trips, that they realized that something catastrophic must have happened, as the Mega Stop looked desolate and mostly abandoned, and it took them a long time to find a victim that did not run away upon seeing them. [3] 

The location consists of the namesake cabin to the north, a small storage shed to the east, and a corpse pit to the west.

The cabin has a living room with a Rocking Chair, a fireplace, and an Asylum Desk with a note on it. Two Ammo Boxes are next to the Couch. Past the living room is a kitchen with a Cooking Stove and a Refrigerator, as well as another note on a stand. From the kitchen, the northern door leads to the back of the cabin, with the western door leading into a tiny bedroom with yet another note.

Other than a Weapons Workbench, the eastern shack has little of note, while the corpse pit to the west contains bones of the former student's victims. A Glowing Wendigo may be seen sitting in one of the trees, on the cliff behind the cabin.

The location has several references, such as the presence of a dark yellow car or similarities in the cabin's layout, to The Knowby Cabin from the original *Evil Dead* horror film trilogy. When a user on Reddit complained about a missing fruit cellar (a location from the second film), level designer Ryan Johnson stated that he had "wanted to add in the cellar but ended up not doing so" due to time constraints. [Dev 1]
